# LOVO AI

> LOVO AI is an award-winning platform offering 500+ AI voices for text-to-speech, video editing, voice cloning, and content creation with emotional expression across 100 languages.

LOVO AI combines multiple content creation tools including Genny, an all-in-one video platform with integrated AI voiceover, auto-subtitle generation, and script writing capabilities. The platform serves creators, educators, and businesses looking to produce professional-quality video and audio content at scale.

## Core Products

- [LOVO: Free AI Voice Generator & Text to Speech](https://lovo.ai): Award-winning AI voice generator with 500+ voices, video editor, and voice cloning.
- [Genny: The All-in-One Video Creation Platform](https://lovo.ai/genny): Genny all-in-one video platform with AI voice, subtitles, and content creation tools.
- [Free Text to Speech Online: 500+ Realistic TTS Voices](https://lovo.ai/text-to-speech): Free AI text-to-speech with 500+ realistic voices in 100 languages with emotional expression.
- [Online Video Editor with Easy Video Editing AI | LOVO AI](https://lovo.ai/online-video-editor): All-in-one video editor combining editing, auto subtitles, and text-to-speech voiceovers.

## AI Features & Tools

- [Custom Voice: Unlimited, unique, branded voice for your content | LOVO AI](https://lovo.ai/custom-voice): Voice cloning feature to create unique, branded voices for content with Genny.
- [Auto Subtitle Generator: Automate Subtitles with Precision | LOVO AI](https://lovo.ai/auto-subtitle-generator): Auto subtitle generator for video accessibility with multilingual support and customization.
- [AI Writer: Write Text Scripts for your Videos Using ChatGPT | LOVO AI](https://lovo.ai/ai-writer): AI script writer using ChatGPT for video and audio content creation with tone customization.
- [AI Image Generator: Create stunning visuals instantly](https://lovo.ai/ai-art-generator): AI image generator transforming text prompts into visuals for video content creation.
